name: Pyoderma faciale (rosacea fulminans)
advice: Stop all face creams and cosmetics; use only a gentle cleanser and plain moisturiser. Pregnancy test before isotretinoin, and reliable contraception during and 1 month after; LFT and fasting lipids at baseline and 1 month. If pregnant, steroid alone is used — no isotretinoin.
